how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-western-plaguelands-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5231:obj:0: Go to Dalson's Tears in ⟦E1⟧ to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the ⟦E2⟧ with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5231:details:0: One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears. No tears will be shed this day, ⟦1⟧; we must ⟦E3⟧ at this cauldron and gain access to it!
rows.quest:5231:details:1: Go to Dalson's Tears, almost due north of Andorhal, and eliminate the cauldron lord there. It should have a key like the last one did, allowing you inside the cauldron's innards. ⟦E4⟧ this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.
rows.quest:5231:progress:0: An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
rows.quest:5231:completion:0: The skeletal key found on the cauldron lord easily slides into a keyhole and then disappears, allowing you permanent access to it. Crude, viscous ichors pulsate through twisted tubes within the cauldrons underpinnings.
rows.quest:5231:completion:1: There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for ⟦E5⟧ Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
rows.quest:5232:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E5⟧ Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5232:details:0: You carefully fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's ichors for what you consider to be suitably sized sample.
rows.quest:5232:details:1: With the poison in hand, it is time to return to ⟦E5⟧ Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
rows.quest:5232:progress:0: We know that each cauldron employs a different mix of reagents to generate its plague-inducing toxin; likewise, we know that we will need to develop a counter agent that is unique for each cauldron. Your sample from Dalson's Tears will be the key to figure out that cauldron's distinct reagent requirement.
rows.quest:5232:completion:0: Ah, there is plenty in here for study. Well done, ⟦2⟧!
rows.quest:5232:completion:1: For now, the next step is in our hands. We'll need to produce a list of reagents that, when combined with what is already in the cauldron, will act as its counter.
rows.quest:5232:completion:2: The only way we will be able to introduce this is by placing the reagents into the cauldron directly. Apothecary Dithers will have more information on that, so be sure to speak with him as soon as possible.
rows.quest:5233:obj:0: Go to the Writhing Haunt in ⟦E1⟧ to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the ⟦E7⟧ with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5233:details:0: Two cauldrons have been successfully opened; while you'll be able to access them indefinitely, we still want to open up the other two that remain. This will provide all of us with more options to introduce the counter agent!
rows.quest:5233:details:1: This time, you'll be hitting the Writhing Haunt's cauldron. It is almost due east of Andorhal, relatively close to the ruined city walls; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. ⟦E4⟧ this bottle to obtain the sample from the cauldron.
rows.quest:5233:progress:0: An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened.  In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
rows.quest:5233:completion:0: The cauldron lord's key unlocks the access panel to this cauldron and then disappears, much like the other keys have for the previous ones you've dealt of. A putrid smelling substance churns violently beneath the platform of the cauldron.
rows.quest:5233:completion:1: There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for ⟦E5⟧ Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
rows.quest:5234:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E8⟧ to ⟦E5⟧ Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5234:details:0: You delicately top off the empty bottle; a sample of the foul substance that churns under the platform of the cauldron now oozes back and forth inside the fragile glass container.
rows.quest:5234:details:1: With the poison in hand, it is time to return to ⟦E5⟧ Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
rows.quest:5234:progress:0: Once we successfully analysis the sample drawn from the Writhing Haunt's cauldron, it will provide us with a third avenue to deliver a devastating counter agent against the Scourge!
rows.quest:5234:completion:0: Another finely executed mission, ⟦4⟧! This makes three cauldrons available to us to turn against the Scourge. If Kel'Thuzad's necromantic dominance over these lands wasn't as strong as it currently is, I'd dare say you'd shut them down completely!
rows.quest:5234:completion:1: Apothecary Dithers will have a report on what this cauldron - as well as the other cauldrons subverted - will require to deliver our counter agent to the plague. With that, the time has come to bring the last cauldron of the west under our influence!

Our ⟦E23⟧ dwells within, conducting unspeakable acts of depravity on unwitting victims... at least, we surmise as much. A door bars the way, and try as we might no entry is to be had without a proper key.
rows.quest:5533:details:1: Alchemist Arbington is well versed on ⟦E22⟧, and has an idea how to obtain a key. You have proved your worth to me, and now I entrust this task to you. Speak with him on this matter.
rows.quest:5533:completion:0: Well met, ⟦49⟧. I've dedicated a fair portion of my recent studies to the ⟦E22⟧, and I believe I know a means by which you can acquire a key... one that will let you past the front door.
rows.quest:5533:completion:1: I can only imagine what horrid sights are to be seen inside, ⟦50⟧. I don't know how you heroic types do it sometimes...
rows.quest:5903:obj:0: ⟦E4⟧ the ⟦E24⟧ on the Termite Mounds in ⟦E25⟧. After you've gathered 100 ⟦E26⟧, return to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5903:details:0: I've tried many times to rout out the ⟦E27⟧ through force alone, but to no avail. So, as an alternative, I've decided to make their lives more difficult.
rows.quest:5903:details:1: If you are willing to help, I want to infest that lumber mill with the most terrible species of termites ever found.
rows.quest:5903:details:2: In Plaguewood, near the once-great ⟦E28⟧, there is a breed that survived the plague and the Scourge combined. Find their mounds and fill this jar with them, so we can prepare them to be unleashed on the Crusade.
rows.quest:5903:progress:0: Did you find the termite mounds, ⟦51⟧? I've heard they are all over Plaguewood.
rows.quest:5903:completion:0: These will do nicely, ⟦52⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:5903:completion:1: If you're ready, we can get on with the next step.
rows.quest:5904:obj:0: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in ⟦E1⟧ to place the ⟦E29⟧.
rows.quest:5904:details:0: Now that we have the termites, take this steel reinforced barrel to the Northridge Lumber Mill south of Hearthglen--you'll find it to the west of the road that leads you up to the town.
rows.quest:5904:details:1: Once there, place the barrel in the center of the lumber mill; find someplace suitable, like on a crate and then open it. The termites should do their work from there and make the mill useless to the Crusade.
rows.quest:5904:completion:0: The termites are obviously getting restless as you place the barrel on top of the crate.
rows.quest:6389:obj:0: Release the ⟦E26⟧ in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the ⟦E29⟧ to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6389:details:0: You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.
rows.quest:6389:details:1: You set your feet and pray that you'll be able to get out of the mill before the termites get to you.
rows.quest:6389:progress:0: Have you done it, ⟦53⟧? Have you released the termites? The Light help us if the ⟦E27⟧ were able to hold onto both the mill and Hearthglen. They should have neither. They're just capitalizing on the victims of the last war and should be put down like rabid animals!
rows.quest:6389:completion:0: Haha! Thank you, ⟦54⟧! You've done it! My father's spirit can now rest and I can live in peace.
rows.quest:6389:completion:1: Thank you again. If there is anything I can do for you, please, just ask.
rows.quest:6390:obj:0: Release the ⟦E26⟧ in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the ⟦E29⟧ to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in ⟦E30⟧.
rows.quest:6390:details:0: You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.
rows.quest:6390:details:1: You set your feet and pray that you'll be able to get out of the mill before the termites get to you.
rows.quest:6390:progress:0: Have you done it, ⟦55⟧? Have you released the termites in the lumber mill?⟦56⟧⟦57⟧It was bad enough that my family lost their jobs and lives, but then to see the place where my childhood was spent taken over by those disgusting so-called holy men... pfah!!
rows.quest:6390:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦58⟧. Here, take this coin. I'm sorry it's not more, but try to take some joy in helping destroy the ⟦E27⟧'s efforts!
rows.quest:4971:obj:0: ⟦E4⟧ the ⟦E31⟧ near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.
rows.quest:4971:obj:1: Slay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the ⟦E31⟧ to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4971:details:0: Tampering of the timeline by a sinister force - most likely the Scourge - has occurred in Andorhal! I can try to keep the passage of time here intact and mend what has been damaged, but I'll need your help to do so uninterrupted.
rows.quest:4971:details:1: Temporal parasites - carrion that feed on the strands of time's altered flow - now infest the silos of Andorhal. A blue pulse of distortion is their only visual marker. They slow my auguries; please ⟦59⟧, help me by using this temporal displacer to ⟦E32⟧ out these parasites.
rows.quest:4971:progress:0: Temporal parasites are a common malady present wherever the flow of time has been tampered with.  I sense that many are present, and this is disturbing.⟦60⟧⟦61⟧Rooting out whatever ones you can find will help me be able to take a better hold on the deteriorating temporal situation here.  I will be able to sense when this has been achieved.
rows.quest:4971:completion:0: Time feels easier to mend now, thank you ⟦62⟧. While you might not understand fully the consequences of a fractured timeline, I appreciate that you understand the urgency of countering what I suspect more and more to be a Scourge-driven malfeasance.
rows.quest:4971:completion:1: I see no harm in rewarding you for your assistance, mortal. Your greatest feats are to come, and the awarding of a bauble will certainly not alter your future destiny. Your continued aid, however, is something that I and the dragonflight could use...
rows.quest:4972:obj:0: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4972:details:0: I need you to reach into the world beyond this room, ⟦63⟧. Allow me to explain.
rows.quest:4972:details:1: You see the difference in this room compared to the rest of Andorhal. My dragonflight works in many different ways and in many different timelines. To mend Andorhal's ⟦E33⟧, I now act from a different timeline as not to overly contaminate it. To continue this though I need time trinkets, ones trapped from when the plague ⟦E34⟧. Find them in lockboxes found in the ruined buildings that make up this once proud city.
rows.quest:4972:progress:0: The time trinkets I seek are simple devices. They are watches mainly, and their hands are trapped forever when the plague first ravaged Andorhal.⟦64⟧⟦65⟧Time is never ending, and the watches you bring to me will invariably find themselves counted out back to their homes... that is, so long as the disturbances continue here.
rows.quest:4972:completion:0: These are exactly what I need, ⟦66⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:4972:completion:1: Allow me to suitably reward you with this. You may not understand what you would need with such a device. You might not even know quite what it really is. Alas, I cannot tell you when you will find it most useful; just know that at some point in the future, you may find this item to have extreme utility and function when consumed. Whether or not you choose to hold on to it until then... this, my friend, is up to you.
rows.quest:4985:obj:0: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4985:details:0: To the east of where we are, near where the ⟦E25⟧ begin, once proud and majestic grizzlies roamed the countryside. The plague released by the Scourge has sundered these beasts too. They wander the countryside, agonized by the stiffening of their muscles and the rotting of their fur and flesh.
rows.quest:4985:details:1: I ask of you to end their misery as well. The only cure for their suffering is a swift death, one that must be ministered by your hand.
rows.quest:4985:progress:0: I hear your footsteps, ⟦67⟧. My vision has faded from me, but I still am able to sense things around me. Have you ended the misery of the disease-ridden grizzlies?
rows.quest:4985:completion:0: "I know that the grizzles have been put down, their torment at an end. I... I have one more thing for you. I wrote it down on... on this branch, sensing that my time in this realm had come to an end.
rows.quest:4985:completion:1: Indeed... I am at that end. Thank you again friend... the creatures of this accursed land may rest... and now shall I."
rows.quest:4985:completion:2: With that, a heavy sigh is uttered by the druid, followed by what sounds like a death rattle. His body lies motionless on the cottage floor.
rows.quest:4986:obj:0: Based on the magic enchanted within the ⟦E35⟧, its delivery to the ⟦E36⟧ in ⟦E37⟧ is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.
rows.quest:4986:details:0: The lifeless hand of the tauren druid clutches a surprisingly healthy looking oaken branch. Examining the branch reveals glyphs of a druidic nature carved into the bark.
rows.quest:4986:details:1: As you grasp the branch, you notice it is warm to the touch, more than it should be. The image of the ⟦E38⟧ tree enters your mind - ⟦E37⟧ specifically - and the words "⟦E36⟧" are on the tip of your tongue. It would appear that the suggestion of where to take the branch has been placed within it.
rows.quest:4986:progress:0: On behalf of the ⟦E36⟧, I bid you welcome to this enclave, ⟦68⟧.  What business do you have with us?
rows.quest:4986:completion:0: This... this is quite strange. This druid - this tauren druid no less - entrusted you with a great deal of valuable information on the extent of the Scourge's plague. I am surprised a tauren would give a ⟦69⟧ such information, and freely at that if what you say is true. We will make good use of this, I promise you. Perhaps the tauren have not fallen as far from Cenarius as Fandral would believe...
rows.quest:4986:completion:1: Erm, anyway, please - accept this as a token of thanks from the ⟦E36⟧.

rows.quest:4987:progress:0: On behalf of the ⟦E36⟧, I bid you welcome to this enclave, ⟦70⟧. What business do you have with us?
rows.quest:4987:completion:0: This is from Mulgris, you say? We had heard he sought to minister to the creatures suffering in the ⟦E13⟧, but this is most unexpected... and most saddening. Mulgris is... was a good friend. I will mourn his passing deeply.
rows.quest:4987:completion:1: His efforts have not gone in vain, thanks to your diligence. In this branch, much lore is stored about the plague the Scourge propagates upon the land. We will study it diligently. As for you, please accept this. It is the least we can do for your noble efforts.
rows.quest:5097:obj:0: Using the ⟦E41⟧, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
